# Belarus–Taiwan & East Asia Platform

> An independent initiative connecting Belarus, Taiwan and East Asia through research, education, cultural exchange and civic dialogue.

The website publishes articles, research summaries, news and event information in English, Belarusian, Russian, Polish and Traditional Chinese. Language paths are /en, /by, /ru, /pl and /zh. Belarusian uses the language code be and the URL path /by.

Some translated pages contain summaries of Russian-language publications. The language of a linked full text is stated on its article page. Conference reports describe participation in a panel; the platform is not necessarily the event organiser. Dates on event pages refer to the event, while dates on news pages refer to the report.

## Project

- [Platform overview](https://belarus-taiwan.org/about-platform.md): Plain-text project description, languages and contact details.
- [About the platform](https://belarus-taiwan.org/en/about): Mission and activities.
- [Contact](https://belarus-taiwan.org/en/contacts): Cooperation and publication enquiries.

## Publications and activities

- [Articles](https://belarus-taiwan.org/en/articles): Research, analysis and guides.
- [News](https://belarus-taiwan.org/en/news): Reports and platform updates.
- [Events](https://belarus-taiwan.org/en/events): Lectures, discussions and conferences.
- [Taiwan’s White Terror](https://belarus-taiwan.org/en/articles/incident-228-white-terror-taiwan-2025): Summary of a 2025 research article; the linked full text is in Russian.
- [Taiwan’s anti-nuclear movement](https://belarus-taiwan.org/en/articles/pobeda-nad-aes-spustya-sorok-let-protestov-i-takoe-vozmozhno1): An article published on September 15, 2025.

## Languages

- [English](https://belarus-taiwan.org/en): English version.
- [Беларуская](https://belarus-taiwan.org/by): Belarusian version.
- [Русский](https://belarus-taiwan.org/ru): Russian version.
- [Polski](https://belarus-taiwan.org/pl): Polish version.
- [繁體中文](https://belarus-taiwan.org/zh): Traditional Chinese version.
